messages:
Maya: quick recap from today's roadmap huddle. Proposing a 'profiles-first' installer: minimal-airgap, vpc-controlled, relay-gateway, tenant-nat. Objective: make upgrades orthogonal to network topology so customers can pick a profile and have predictable upgrade semantics. Launch criteria idea: (a) passing rolling-upgrade tests for vpc-controlled and tenant-nat, (b) migration guide + rollback playbook, (c) egress-preservation SLO + security checklist.

Dave: sounds reasonable. Engineering ask: define canonical mapping from profile -> runtime flags and config keys. I'll sketch INSTALL_PROFILE, EGRESS_MODE, RELAY_MODE flags and add them to the operator config. Need matrix in CI covering cross-profile upgrades.

Elaine: from field: several customers require stable egress IPs across upgrades (security appliances whitelist). Tenant-nat customers worry NAT mapping flips during cutover. Need concrete rollback hooks and a test harness that simulates IPAM integration.

Dave: implementation note: relay-gateway profile can preserve egress by routing outbound through managed relays. We'll add a --egress-mode=preserve option. For tenant-nat, propose a nat-export to emit mappings so customer's IPAM can pre-seed. Example usage:
```bash
./installer apply --profile=relay-gateway --egress-mode=preserve --nat-export=true
```
This writes /var/lib/redwood/nat-mapping.json with {service->ip} mappings for ops to consume.

Samir: a customer asked for "agentless zero-downtime" upgrade path. They can't run sidecars or add proxies. Can we do in-place rolling upgrades with passive TCP proxying at the kernel/netfilter layer? Low-risk but adds complexity.

Maya: passive-proxy is doable but increases attack surface and testing burden. Prioritization proposal: 1) vpc-controlled (highest-dollar deals), 2) egress-preserve features (security sensitive), 3) tenant-nat automation and IPAM hooks (field ops). Passive-proxy as a follow-up spike.

security: flagging requirements 14: any nat-export or egress-preserve flow must be KMS-wrapped, signed, and logged to an immutable audit log. Add to release checklist: KMS integration, read-only export keys, audit trail, and data retention policy.

ops-bot: nightly staging job started: deploy profile=vpc-controlled job=6421 :rocket:

Dave: concrete action items: - prototype nat-export + installer flags (owner: dave) - CI upgrade matrix across minimal-airgap, vpc-controlled, relay-gateway (owner: ci-team) - docs + migration guide skeleton (owner: maya) - security checklist + KMS work (owner: security). Target: vpc-controlled MVP in ~6w.

Elaine: i'll surface two customer cases (one tenant-nat, one relay-gateway) for the sync. Need test definitions for egress-stability.

Maya: booking 30m follow-up with eng + netops + field TOMORROW. @elaine @dave @samir bring repros and failing cases per profile. We'll finalize launch criteria then. Closing thread.
